definitions.mechanicSuitable: A mapped meaningful control and required response mode exist in both backend and React; semantic/material requirements still gate every generated activity.
definitions.liveComposedGenerated: An actual-provider composition from an initially empty library passed the CURRENT component/prompt versions through a real upload, without reusing a finished activity.
definitions.liveComposedPlayed: That current live composition completed the independent challenge and reached protected parent history with an automatic or explicit parent outcome.
definitions.generatedValidated: A current-map evidence record identifies an actual generated definition that passed activity validation and independent review.
definitions.playedScored: A current-map generated activity was actually completed and scored, including explicit parent review when required. Pending review is not scored.
